gates.detail: No authenticated Overleaf browser import and new-word edit has been performed. Local pdfLaTeX and CI are different evidence.
A person other than the implementation agent must reproduce the documented installation from a clean source archive.
Earlier expanded reference-form acceptance is recorded separately. Native document review must be explicitly attributed and scoped; per-case approvals must not be invented.
The prior 100-page distinct-token workload exceeded 90 seconds. Extended-budget completion measures throughput but does not satisfy this interactive target.
No font binaries are distributed. Exact supported-font dependency and any compiled-profile redistribution policy need review before public release.
BnTeX remains a working name. CTAN catalogue/name-confusion review and any maintainer discussion have not been finalized.
Current authorization covers private consolidation and release preparation only, not public GitHub releases, visibility changes, CTAN or PyPI publication.
